title: smallSubgroup_sidonModNeg IS fully-split ideal-SVP NON-EXISTENCE at shortest length
evidence: Ran existing probe_407_sparse_support_ideal_svp.py + new scripts/probes/_407_conn/C032_existence_vs_mass.py (exact integer enumeration of balanced 2r-relations of mu_n in F_p, prize-regime proper-subgroup primes n=8/16/32, beta=4,5, odd_part((p-1)/n)>1). TWO findings. (1) DICTIONARY CONFIRMED (the true, mildly-insightful part): the r=2 brick exactly = 'no sparse-support (signed-sum-of-<=4-roots) defect point of the split ideal'. Distinct defect points T(r) first appear exactly when the norm wall (2r)^phi crosses p: n=32 p=2^20 has T=0 for r=2,3 (where (2r)^phi<p, matching smallSubgroup_sidonModNeg / no_spurious_tuple_of_lt_prime) and T=16 at r=4 with minNorm=2097218~2p (a genuine ideal point of norm ~p). So the r=2 <-> length-4-non-existence framing is accurate. (2) CENTRAL CLAIM REFUTED AS A ROUTE: the connection asserts the general open core IS the SAME statement (existence/non-existence of a short sparse ideal vector at house<=2r), making the prize a 'quantitative continuation' of the non-existence code. But the LIVE quantity is representation MASS M=E_r-E_r^(0) (the BGK char-sum wall: B^{2r}<=q*E_r, prize needs E_r~E_r^(0)=(2r-1)!!n^r up to r~ln q), NOT existence T. Once defects appear, existence is VACUOUSLY decided NO by Minkowski: the split prime ideal of norm p in dim phi(n)=n/2 has lambda_1 ~ sqrt(phi)*p^(1/phi); in the prize regime p^(1/phi)->1 so lambda_1=O(sqrt n). Probe confirms minHouse=5.11 (n=32), 9.09 (n=16) -- tracking the sqrt(phi)/sqrt(n) Minkowski scale, FAR below the box house<=2r (=8,10). So short ideal vectors ALWAYS exist => 'ideal-SVP non-existence at house<=2r' / 'shortest length' is decided NO for free; it is NOT the open quantity. The open quantity is M/E_r0 (n=32 r=5: 0.0518, growing in r), i.e. controlling the MASS once the 2r-box meets the ideal. This is exactly the W-idealSVP / Bourgain-Shkredov-equidistribution wall already recorded in CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold.lean's own honesty note ('controlling the representation mass once the prime sublattice meets the 2r-box ... is NOT addressed here'). Extending r=2 to r~ln q is therefore NOT 'prove short vectors don't exist' (they do) but 'control their representation mass' = the open BGK wall, not a continuation of the existence proof.
reduced_to: The defect-onset open core is NOT sparse-ideal-SVP NON-existence at house<=2r (that is vacuously FALSE in the prize regime by Minkowski lambda_1=O(sqrt n)). It is the representation-MASS bound: in the regime (2r)^phi>=p where short sparse ideal vectors DO exist, bound the total mass M_r = E_r(mu_n)-E_r^(0) = sum over defect points of R_r(z) so that E_r ~ (2r-1)!!n^r up to r~ln q. This is the Bourgain-Shkredov equidistribution / BGK sqrt-cancellation wall (faces 3<->4 of the open core), restated as the cyclotomic-ideal mass-distribution problem, NOT an existence/SVP problem.
wall: W-idealSVP (= BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation, mass face): the open quantity is the representation mass of sparse defects of the fully-split ideal once they exist, equivalently E_r(mu_n) staying ~Gaussian to r~ln q; existence of short ideal vectors is vacuously yes (Minkowski) and gives no leverage.
honest_note: The connection's underlying dictionary is genuinely correct and modestly insightful: the in-tree axiom-clean r=2 brick (smallSubgroup_sidonModNeg) and CyclotomicNormDefectThreshold ARE the r=2 instance of a cyclotomic-ideal short-vector statement, and the norm-wall onset (2r)^phi=p is real (probe-verified). What is refuted is only the load-bearing inference that the PRIZE is a 'quantitative continuation' of that non-existence code -- because the prize quantity is mass, not existence, and existence is vacuously decided by Minkowski in the prize regime. No closure is claimed; the BGK/idealSVP-mass wall stands unbroken. Numerics are exact integer enumeration but limited to small n (8/16/32) by the multiset-enumeration cost; the asymptotic minHouse~sqrt(phi) and mass-growth claims are extrapolations from these exact small-n points consistent with Minkowski/Lam-Leung theory, not an asymptotic proof. Probes: scripts/probes/probe_407_sparse_support_ideal_svp.py and scripts/probes/_407_conn/C032_existence_vs_mass.py.
